$comment: Method-and-capture evidence backing every reader-facing candidacy field in thesis-candidacy.json. Each criterion records what was measured, where, how, when (UTC), what was excluded, what was found, and where a stranger can re-check. Negative results are scoped to the defined search, never asserted as exhaustive. Refreshing this file is a reviewed action, not part of any build. Every observation carries an independence classification under independencePolicy; only unsolicited-unaffiliated observations count toward pass conditions, and each exclusion decision is recorded with its criterion.

independentIntegrations.definition: A public repository, package, or application that reads /registry/zodiacs.registry.json or depends on @zodiacs/sdk and is not operated by Zodiacs.org, Astrofolio, or the SDK’s own examples.
sourcesSearched: npm registry metadata: https://registry.npmjs.org/@zodiacs/sdk (versions 1.0.0-rc.1, 1.0.0, 1.0.1; latest published 2026-06-07): docs/thesis-evidence/2026-11-10/npm-downloads.json

web search: "@zodiacs/sdk" OR "zodiacs.registry.json" -site:zodiacs.org (no consumers found; results were the operator's own SDK repository and unrelated packages named zodash, zodiac-os, zoolabs and Gnosis Zodiac)
independentIntegrations.method: Package-registry lookup plus keyword search for the two machine-readable identifiers a consumer must reference. npm exposes no public dependents API; dependents were checked only via the searches above.
independentIntegrations.exclusions: Zodiacs.org properties, Astrofolio properties, @zodiacs/sdk’s own examples, owner-controlled accounts.
independentIntegrations.result: No qualifying results found in the defined search. Not exhaustive: private, unpublished, or unindexed integrations would not be found; no code-search source was queried. Download counts include automated installs and are not evidence of a consumer.

thirdPartyCitations.definition: An editorial mention of zodiacs.org or one of its twelve canonical mint addresses by an independent publication, i.e. written by a person rather than generated from chain data.
sourcesSearched: web search: "zodiacs.org" -site:zodiacs.org registry OR thesis OR zodiac tokens
web search: "GhFiFrExPY3proVF96oth1gESWA5QPQzdtb8cy8b1YZv" OR "8Cd7wXoPb5Yt9cUGtmHNqAEmpMDrhfcVqnGbLC48b8Qm" (aries and leo canonical mints)
thirdPartyCitations.method: Search-engine queries for the site and for two canonical mint addresses as citation anchors; every hit classified as editorial, automated listing, or owner-adjacent.
thirdPartyCitations.exclusions: Astrofolio properties (owner-adjacent by counting rule regardless of control); automated wallet/aggregator listings (Solflare price pages, CryptoDB dataset record) — observed, listed below, not counted.
thirdPartyCitations.result: No qualifying editorial citations found in the defined searches. Observed and excluded: aggregator token pages (CoinMarketCap, Zerion) for similarly named tokens and an automated listing; the operator's own SDK repository. The mint-address query returned no pages that mention either address. Not exhaustive: two search queries cannot cover all publications; the other ten mints were not individually queried.

holderDispersion.definition: Median and range of per-sign top-10 token-account share, from the repository’s weekly public distribution snapshots (public/assets/distribution.json, refreshed by the distribution-refresh workflow).
sourcesSearched: git history of public/assets/distribution.json on origin/main
holderDispersion.method: git show <sha>:public/assets/distribution.json for every commit touching the file; per snapshot, median and min–max of signs[*].top10Pct.
holderDispersion.capturedAtUtc: 2026-07-23T04:30:00Z (extraction); snapshot dates are the capturedAt fields inside each committed file
holderDispersion.exclusions: None; all four existing snapshots used.
holderDispersion.result: Four weekly snapshots exist: 2026-06-29 median 26.62% (range 23.2–28.9), 2026-07-06 median 26.62% (23.2–28.9), 2026-07-13 median 27.16% (23.0–30.6), 2026-07-20 median 27.16% (23.0–30.6). Baseline established; no widening — the median moved slightly toward concentration. Not refreshed on 2026-11-10: no keyless public Solana RPC answered getTokenLargestAccounts (see docs/thesis-evidence/2026-11-10/rpc-endpoint-probe.json), so the weekly snapshot has not changed since 2026-08-24 and this row keeps its July date.

liquidityPersistence.definition: Whether each sign’s canonical Raydium pool (the reviewed pool addresses published in the instrument disclosure) exists and holds liquidity at capture, plus the pool-creation date Dexscreener reports.
sourcesSearched: Dexscreener pair endpoint per canonical pool and token endpoint per mint: docs/thesis-evidence/2026-11-10/dexscreener.json

Solana RPC getSignaturesForAddress on each canonical pool and getTransaction on the newest signatures until one logs a swap instruction (api.mainnet-beta.solana.com): docs/thesis-evidence/2026-11-10/pool-trades.json
GeckoTerminal daily candles per pool (cross-check; 9 of 12 requests rate-limited): docs/thesis-evidence/2026-11-10/geckoterminal.json
liquidityPersistence.method: One Dexscreener call per pool and per mint, matched by the reviewed pool address; liquidity.usd and volume.h24 recorded where returned. Separately, each pool's newest transactions were read on chain and the newest one whose logs record a swap instruction is recorded with its signature. The twelve per-pool records are embedded below.
liquidityPersistence.exclusions: Non-canonical pools (stray Meteora pairs) observed but not counted toward the canonical-pool claim.
liquidityPersistence.result: 12 of 12 canonical Raydium pools traded on chain in the 30 days before the 2026-11-10 capture (every pool's newest swap fell on 9 or 10 Nov) · Dexscreener returned 9 of the 12 pools: $10.5k to $18.7k depth, $0.88 to $100 of 24h volume · Leo, Scorpio and Aquarius were not returned by Dexscreener · continuous historical depth was not archived. Libra's pool is thin, so small trades move its figures a long way.

archiveContinuity.definition: HTTP-200 Internet Archive captures of zodiacs.org since 2024-01-01 (one per day via collapse), and which of them are counted as this site: count, earliest, latest, and largest day-gap of the counted captures. Plus the date the public repository’s commit history begins.
sourcesSearched: Wayback CDX API with content digests, read 2026-11-13T11:21:08Z: https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=zodiacs.org&output=json&fl=timestamp,statuscode,digest,length&filter=statuscode:200&collapse=timestamp:8&from=20240101
Captures 20260610083004 and 20261011021828, opened 2026-11-13: titles "Zodiacs · The Twelve." and one beginning "Zodiacs.org" and continuing "Free Birth Charts, Sign Guides & Astrology Tools"
archiveContinuity.method: One CDX query; the raw response rows are embedded below; the gap statistic is computed from consecutive capture dates.
archiveContinuity.exclusions: Non-200 captures and captures before 2024. Also the ten captures dated 2024-07-26 to 2025-07-19: the Archive gives all ten the same content digest (7HMQKXUYPBZDUEQGHND5JINF6WGD5MPJ), and this register does not establish what the domain served in 2024 and 2025, so they are not counted as this site. They stay in cdxRows below.
archiveContinuity.result: 13 captures of the domain since 2024-01-01. Counted as this site: 3, each with its own digest (20260610, 20260710, 20261011); largest gap 93 days (20260710 → 20261011). Not counted: 10 captures from 20240726 to 20250719 that share one digest. The public repository’s commit history begins 2026-05-27 (github.com/zodiacs-org/site, first commit 6370da54). Reworded 2026-11-13: the earlier text counted all 13 captures as this site’s and described the repository archive as continuous since 2024; the CDX rows are unchanged.

independencePolicy.rule: Only unsolicited-unaffiliated observations count toward any candidacy pass condition. Operator, related-party, paid, prompted, and coordinated activity is recorded and excluded. Prompted mentions are recorded as prompted.
